sections: Global authority lock order and retained observations

repo_truth: Definition/profile, canonical Charter, intake evaluator, lifecycle state machine, append-only lineage store, promotion transaction, native strict reads, and CTAP codec/security primitives are present in the shared worktree. Compiler/CLI mutation adapters remain intentionally fail-closed until this lane lands engine-owned services.
allowed_scope: Add narrowly factored engine workflow modules and focused hcm_2_2 authority tests for author persistence, approval construction/persistence, promotion/lifecycle record builders, persistent approver-registry operations, and exact native-port composition.

Edit crates/engine/src/approver_registry.rs and crates/engine/src/charter_authenticator.rs only after required GitNexus impact analysis; coordinate additive crates/engine/src/lib.rs exports with the parent.
Consume, but do not weaken or duplicate, TrustedLineageStoreV1 and CharterAuthorityTransactionServiceV1.
Use RED tests first and run with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=D:\codex-build\handbook-hcm22 and TEMP/TMP=D:\codex-temp\handbook-hcm22.
non_goals: Do not edit definitions, profiles, compiler, CLI, flow, Environment Inventory, skills, proof/control, planning, handoff, ledger, or other dispatch files.
Do not accept caller-supplied semantic records, ceremony refs, fingerprints, native response files, software signatures, weaker fallback authority, or HCM-2.3 scope.
Do not commit or create handoffs, ledger rows, dispatches, or user-visible task hops.
tasks: Read the complete dispatch, exact authority sections/vectors, and live engine modules.
Implement engine-owned atomic author persistence for exact intake/candidate JCS plus normalized candidate content.
Implement approval construction/persistence from committed candidate, registry pair, native assertion, waiver ordering, and shared authenticator-use authority; refuse before delta on any mismatch.
Implement promotion/lifecycle record builders that re-resolve retained lineage and call the existing promotion transaction service without compiler-side semantic construction.
Complete persistent bootstrap/add/revoke/update registry operations behind the four frozen signatures and caller-intent-only request/result DTOs, including exact unavailable all-null refusal.
Return exact implemented versus remaining protocol coverage, changed files, RED/GREEN evidence, impacts, and product integration signatures.
contracts_and_gates: No compiler/CLI adapter constructs a semantic record or supplies ceremony identity.
Every success publishes only exact content-addressed records after the authority transaction commit; every refusal has null semantic refs and no changed paths.
All candidate/approval/promotion basis, registry pair, external refs, and fingerprints are re-resolved from committed engine state.
Unsupported or unavailable native authority refuses before platform calls, journals, records, canonical truth, registry state, or lifecycle delta.
stop_conditions: Stop before any HIGH or CRITICAL existing-symbol edit and return the blast radius to the parent.
Return blocked if the frozen DTOs or exact vectors conflict with the live transaction service without a packet-authorized resolution.
Return bounded gaps rather than inventing HCM-2.3 or weakening native authority.
